# Danube Automation

> Odoo Community implementation, integrations, custom Odoo module development and AI agents for small and mid-sized companies. Team based in Novi Sad, Serbia (Central European Time), working with clients in Europe and the United States. Independent; not affiliated with Odoo S.A.

## Services
- [Odoo Community implementation](https://danubeautomation.com/services/odoo-community-implementation): phased, fixed-price setup of sales, inventory, purchasing, manufacturing and invoicing, with data migration and training.
- [Odoo integrations](https://danubeautomation.com/services/odoo-integrations): Shopify, couriers, banks, e-invoicing, label printers, scales and REST/SOAP APIs.
- [Custom Odoo modules](https://danubeautomation.com/services/custom-odoo-modules): shop-floor kiosks, labels, B2B portals, dashboards, Community replacements for Enterprise-only features. Delivered under LGPL-3 in the client's Git repository.
- [AI agents for Odoo](https://danubeautomation.com/services/ai-agents-for-odoo): agents that turn WhatsApp messages, emails and voice notes into draft sales orders for human approval; MCP agents over Odoo data.
- [White-label development for Odoo partners](https://danubeautomation.com/for-odoo-partners)

## Products
- [MCP Devices](https://mcpdevices.com): local agent that connects printers, scanners and scales to Odoo and AI agents over MCP and REST.
